title: Priesthood of Believers
definition: The Priesthood of Believers teaches that all Christians have access to God through Christ and are called to offer spiritual sacrifices.
summary: The Priesthood of Believers teaches that all Christians have direct access to God through Christ and are called to offer spiritual service.
christFocus: Jesus Christ is the great High Priest who opens access to the Father for His people.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content: This doctrine focuses on access and ministry shared by all believers. Because Christ is the final High Priest, believers approach God through Him and serve as a holy priesthood. It does not erase church leadership, but it rejects the idea that only a special class can draw near to God or serve spiritually.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: This matters because believers may become passive if they think ministry belongs only to professionals. The priesthood of believers dignifies prayer, worship, witness, sacrifice, and service from every Christian. It also protects the Church from spiritual elitism.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Approach God confidently through Christ in prayer and worship. Use your access to intercede for others. Serve as a spiritual priest by offering your body, praise, generosity, and witness to God.
